title: Quarterly radial reset and exec action map
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact, operational-first playbook to run a quarter-reset across product, infra, and go-to-market using a radial priority map instead of a linear backlog. Goal is to arrive at a 60-day executable action map for the execs to approve at the next leadership sync, and a short all-hands script that clarifies trade-offs and asks.

Why 'radial'?
- We want visibility into cross-cutting constraints (capacity, cost, quality, compliance) and the primary axis for each team (Speed, Reliability, Cost, Adoption).
- The radial map surfaces collisions (e.g., performance optimizations that increase infra ops vs. product speed bets) so leadership can make explicit trade-offs during the exec decision.

Topline ask for Execs (decisions we need this week):
1) Prioritize latency SLOs vs unit-cost reduction for hosted API non-enterprise routes. (Option A: maintain current P95 target; Option B: relax by 10% and shift to more aggressive batching/quantization).
2) Approve 60-day Dedicated capacity reallocation: move 20% of GPU-reserved pool from experimental to steady-state for two high-throughput customers, with a 30-day rollback clause.
3) Greenlight two Private pilot installs (healthcare, finance) and approve limited on-prem packaging budget ($75k).

Signals & metrics to present at the decision meeting:
- Hosted API: P95 gen latency (global) — current 340ms; target 300ms for Q2.
- Unit token cost (hosted): $0.00115 -> target $0.00095 via caching+batches.
- Dedicated commit utilization: 68% average (spikes to 92% regionally).
- Private pipeline: 3 qualified leads (LOI stage), expected PO within 90 days.
- Console adoption: 42% of enterprise accounts have adopted the rollouts dashboard; target 70%.

60-day action map (radial spokes with owners and checkpoints):
- Product (spoke: Speed): Owner: Priya Nair. Deliverables: trimmed request path for small responses (2–8 tokens) + SDK patch with streaming defaults. Checkpoint: prototype by D+21, rollout flag gated to 10%.
- Serving Runtime (spoke: Reliability): Owner: Ethan Rivera. Deliverables: kernel selection automation for 2 new model families + automated fallback policy. Checkpoint: Canary in us-west on D+28.
- Optimize (spoke: Cost): Owner: Lena Zhou. Deliverables: batching profile changes, prefix cache tuning, and quantization playbook for 3 workload archetypes. Checkpoint: Estimated unit-cost reduction validated on sandbox by D+30.
- Dedicated (spoke: Throughput): Owner: Marco Alvarez. Deliverables: reallocation plan, SLA update text, and rollback automation. Checkpoint: Ops runbook and terraform patch ready by D+18.
- Private & Compliance (spoke: Trust): Owner: Jordan Kim. Deliverables: simplified on-prem installer (air-gap checklist) + KMS integration test matrix. Checkpoint: Pilot install window scheduled D+35.
- GTM & Customer Success (spoke: Adoption): Owner: Samira Gupta. Deliverables: targeted playbook for 5 enterprise customers to adopt rollouts & cost dashboards; 2 customer webinars. Checkpoint: playbook dry-run D+40.

Execution playbook (how we move fast):
1) Decision call (Exec sync) on Tuesday — use signals above and a 10-min trade-off framing per decision.
2) Post-decision: spin 4-week working squads (one per radial spoke). Each squad must post a 2-line daily update to #quarterly-radial (Slack) and keep a one-page Notion progress card.
3) Midway checkpoint (D+30): leadership triage — if any spoke is >3 business days behind, exec sponsor must approve either escalation resources or scope reduction.
4) All-hands (D+45): 12-minute segment in the town for the reset: 5-min context, 3-min committed asks, 4-min Q&A with pre-collected questions.

All-hands run-of-show (short script):
- Host: CEO (opening 60s) — one-line framing: "A pragmatic reset so teams can ship the next set of reliability and cost wins."
- Ops lead (Jordan) 3 min — state of signals and the decisions we made.
- Product lead (Priya) 2 min — visible customer impact and how the SDK defaults change.
- Open Q&A (moderated) 4 min — pre-collected questions prioritized; 30s per answer.

Communication artifacts to prepare (owner -> deliverable -> due):
- Exec decision brief (Jordan) -> single-slide decision matrix + one-paragraph ask -> due D-1 before sync.
- All-hands bulletin (Comms) -> 2-paragraph summary + 3 bullets for managers -> due D+5.
- Customer email template (GTM) -> targeted note for top 20 customers about Dedicated reallocation and pilot options -> due D+10.

Risks and mitigations (quick):
- Risk: Dedicated reallocation causes transient tail latency for experimental workloads. Mitigation: automated traffic split and rapid rollback; pre-warm critical paths.
- Risk: Cost-optimization changes degrade output quality. Mitigation: tie any quantization/ batching change to a held-back eval prompt set and quality gates (pre/post metrics).
- Risk: Private pilots exceed provisioning estimate. Mitigation: measure install time in lab and reserve a 10% contingency budget.

Open questions for execs (we need explicit answers):
- How aggressive should we be on the unit-cost target this quarter? (Conservative vs. aggressive).
- Is it acceptable to gate some hosted non-enterprise routes behind slower but cheaper model variants for off-peak?
- Approve $75k packaging budget for 2 private pilots?

Quick timeline snapshot:
- D0 (Decision call): Execs sign off on top 3 asks.
- D+7: squads convened, runbooks drafted.
- D+21: first product + runtime prototypes.
- D+30: midway leadership triage.
- D+45: All-hands segment.
- D+60: Outcome review + next iteration plan.

Notes to the working group (internal tone):
- Keep the radial map lightweight — one slide per spoke. Avoid over-engineered artifacts.
- Prioritize experiments that give clear, measurable economics (latency vs cost vs revenue signal).
- If you need more than 3 full-time engineers for 30+ days, escalate to exec sponsor for headcount reprioritization.

Appendix (short templates):
- Exec decision brief template: 1) Decision; 2) Options with 1-line trade-offs; 3) Key signals; 4) Ask (approve/decline/modify).
- Midpoint triage note: "Spoke X is behind because Y. Proposed fix: Z (time and cost). Exec sponsor decision required: yes/no."

TODOs near-term (owners):
- Jordan: finalize exec deck and post to Confluence by EOD Monday.
- Priya: prototype tiny-response path and SDK patch (D+21).
- Ethan: staging canary plan and rollback automation for kernel selection (D+28).
- Lena: run cost regression on top 5 customer workloads (D+14).
- Marco: prepare terraform patch and ops runbook for Dedicated reallocation (D+18).

Unresolved items to capture in meeting notes:
- Exact wording of customer-facing commitment around SLA during Dedicated reallocation window.
- Whether billing/proration for Dedicated reallocation should be manual or automated.

If you are on a squad: drop a short intro in the #quarterly-radial Slack thread (role, 1-sentence goal, two blockers).

End note: this is intentionally small and opinionated. The benefit of the radial reset is surfacing trade-offs early and forcing an explicit exec decision rather than implicit drift. Expect iteration after the 60-day review.

Document version: v0-1 (working).
